_comment: aowl.resourcepacks — a Minecraft-style resource-pack loader. Packs live as folders under packs/ (each a manifest.json + assets). This file records ONLY which packs are enabled and in what STACK ORDER; the packs themselves stay read-only and shareable. See RESOURCE_PACKS.md for the manifest schema and the settings-page contract.
//swapMode: Texture-swap ladder, passed to the EXISTING texture mod's discipline. off (default, safe) = the loader writes an EMPTY texture manifest, nothing is swapped. probe/match/full escalate exactly as the texture mod documents. Raise this only after boot is confirmed stable.
//driveGrade: false (default) = this mod never touches the post-process and the graphics mod owns the grade. true = enabled grade packs are merged and pushed through the graphics mod's gfx_apply host call (driven-mode Present, no second hook).
//textureManifestOut: Where the flattened texture manifest is written for the texture mod to read. Empty = <modDir>/resolved.manifest.json. To connect it, set aowl.textures' own manifestPath to this path AND its packRoot to "" (the emitted file paths are absolute). Until you do, aowl.textures stays on its committed curated manifest and this file is written but unread. aowl.textures carries loadAfter aowl.resourcepacks so the file exists before it looks.
//packs: Enabled set + STACK ORDER. Array order is load order, index 0 = lowest priority; a later pack overrides earlier ones on any conflicting texture name or grade key, exactly like Minecraft's applied pack list. A pack folder present on disk but absent here is available-but-disabled. Toggle/reorder via the settings endpoint or by editing this array.
